purpose_context: Today only tactics can be read through the charter API and nothing can be written. This mission builds the shared relationship and graph core and takes the regular charter artefacts (directive, styleguide, paradigm, and the new toolguide) through a consistent read and functional-registration surface, so pack authors and tooling can fetch and register artefacts and the relationships between them. Grounded in ADR-0025 and ADR-0026.
purpose_tldr: Let clients read and register the charter's regular artefacts and their relationships through the API.
